shots.action: A lone figure small inside the towering, dim stone storehouse, walking across polished floorboards toward deep shadow.
A lone figure walks along the edge of dark stone cottages where the open moorland begins under a vast starlit sky.
A figure steps forward past an ancient granite marker into the vast dark heather, halting abruptly in the immense quiet.
A figure sits down on a cold mound of dark turf, pulling a heavy dark wool coat tight around his shoulders in the deep shadow.
Over the shoulder of a dark-coated figure gazing into the massive empty expanse of starlit moorland.
A solitary figure sits motionless in stark silhouette against the enormous, star-speckled night sky and towering boundary stones.
A man sits on the cold turf, hands gripping the damp grass in sudden tension, illuminated only by faint starlight under towering granite stones.
A lone figure stands in sharp silhouette against the starry horizon, dark green wool coat pulled tight against the wind, silver braid over one shoulder.
Over a seated man's shoulder, a woman stands tall against the starlit sky, looking down with quiet stillness.
A man's face in stark relief against the dark background, lips parting to speak in the cold night air under dim starlight.
A woman stands motionless beside an ancient granite boundary stone, hands resting in her coat pockets under a vast star-dusted sky.
A seated man stares straight ahead into the darkness, shoulders slightly slumped, hands resting quietly on the cold ground.
